item.title: Rallying Cry – June 23, 2026
item.description: From a young cricket star getting his first India jersey to Arab fans cheering the World Cup in New York, plus breakthroughs in nuclear clocks and dino fossils, today’s good news is full of wins—like heat-resilient exercise tips and students creating the career guide they wish they’d had!
